005package com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
008import org.wpilib.math.util.Units;
009import org.wpilib.units.measure.Angle;
010import org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity;
011
012import com.ctre.phoenix6.BaseStatusSignal;
013import com.ctre.phoenix6.StatusCode;
014import com.ctre.phoenix6.StatusSignal;
015import com.ctre.phoenix6.configs.Pigeon2Configuration;
016import com.ctre.phoenix6.hardware.Pigeon2;
017
018import java.util.Queue;
019
020/** IO implementation for Pigeon 2. */
021public class GyroIOPigeon2 implements GyroIO {
022    private final Pigeon2 pigeon =
023            new Pigeon2(TunerConstants.DrivetrainConstants.Pigeon2Id, TunerConstants.kCANBus);
024    private final StatusSignal<Angle> yaw = pigeon.getYaw();
025    private final Queue<Double> yawPositionQueue;
026    private final Queue<Double> yawTimestampQueue;
027    private final StatusSignal<AngularVelocity> yawVelocity = pigeon.getAngularVelocityZWorld();
028
029    public GyroIOPigeon2() {
030        if (TunerConstants.DrivetrainConstants.Pigeon2Configs != null) {
031            pigeon.getConfigurator().apply(TunerConstants.DrivetrainConstants.Pigeon2Configs);
032        } else {
033            pigeon.getConfigurator().apply(new Pigeon2Configuration());
034        }
035
036        pigeon.getConfigurator().setYaw(0.0);
037        yaw.setUpdateFrequency(Swerve.ODOMETRY_FREQUENCY);
038        yawVelocity.setUpdateFrequency(50.0);
039        pigeon.optimizeBusUtilization();
040        yawTimestampQueue = PhoenixOdometryThread.getInstance().makeTimestampQueue();
041        yawPositionQueue = PhoenixOdometryThread.getInstance().registerSignal(yaw.clone());
042    }
043
044    @Override
045    public void updateInputs(GyroIOInputs inputs) {
046        inputs.connected = BaseStatusSignal.refreshAll(yaw, yawVelocity).equals(StatusCode.OK);
047        inputs.yawPosition = Rotation2d.fromDegrees(yaw.getValueAsDouble());
048        inputs.yawVelocityRadPerSec = Units.degreesToRadians(yawVelocity.getValueAsDouble());
049
050        inputs.odometryYawTimestamps =
051                yawTimestampQueue.stream().mapToDouble((Double value) -> value).toArray();
052        inputs.odometryYawPositions =
053                yawPositionQueue.stream()
054                        .map((Double value) -> Rotation2d.fromDegrees(value))
055                        .toArray(Rotation2d[]::new);
056        yawTimestampQueue.clear();
057        yawPositionQueue.clear();
058    }
059}
